newsitem.title: USA: Aviva Petroleum completes property sale.
newsitem.headline: Aviva Petroleum completes property sale.

text.p: Aviva Petroleum Inc said it closed, on December 23, the sale of all of its United States onshore oil and gas properties for about $3,000,000 in cash.

Out of these proceeds, $2.8 million has been applied to reduce bank debt to just under $8 million at December 31, bringing the company's debt to equity ratio down to about 30 percent, Aviva said. The remainder of the proceeds was added to working capital.
The company now operates both of its remaining U.S. oil and gas properties, which are in the Gulf of Mexico offshore Louisiana, at Main Pass 41 and Breton Sound 31 fields.

Aviva said it is in talks with several prospective industry partners interested in farming-in to the Breton Sound 31 deep prospects indicated by a recently interpreted 3-D seismic survey. (-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
